svg.title: Financial Research Assistant — actual LangGraph workflow
svg.desc: All 17 registered graph nodes, both retry loops, the research branch, four terminal responses, and Admin approval. Connections checked against builder.py and the compiled graph. API work, persistence and SSE are described separately, not drawn as graph nodes.
